item.title: 6 Ways Sony Can Successfully Reboot Its Failed Live-Action SPIDER-VERSE Franchise
item.description: With it now confirmed that Sony Pictures is rebooting its live-action Spider-Verse, we're taking a deep dive into all the ways the studio can make this next iteration actually, you know, work.

item.title: Disney Execs "Pleased" With AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY; Expected To Be 2026's Highest-Grossing Movie
item.description: According to a new report, Disney executives are high on Avengers: Doomsday ahead of its release this December. We also have big updates on Star Wars and Avatar.

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Rumor Reveals Some Shocking Character Deaths At Doom's Hands - SPOILERS
item.description: A wild new Avengers: Doomsday rumour claims to reveal more shocking character deaths in the movie, this time at the hands of Robert Downey Jr.'s villainous Doctor Doom.

item.title: PROJECT HAIL MARY Social Media Reactions Hails Sci-Fi "Masterpiece" As 2026's "First Great Blockbuster"
item.description: The first reactions to Project Hail Mary have just touched down, and it sounds like filmmakers Phil Lord and Christopher Miller have delivered one of the best sci-fi movies ever.

item.title: MORTAL KOMBAT II Trailer And Poster Promise Plenty Of Fatalities As Johnny Cage Takes Center Stage
item.description: We finally have the new trailer for Mortal Kombat II, and this action-packed, bloody sneak peek is all about Johnny Cage, leaving poor Cole Young relegated to minor supporting player.

item.title: PRETTY LETHAL: Ballerinas Get Bloody In First Trailer For New Prime Video Action Thriller
item.description: The first trailer for Pretty Lethal, a new action thriller starring Maddie Ziegler, Lana Condor, Iris Apatow, Avantika, and Uma Thurman, has been released ahead of the movie's SXSW premiere...

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Rumor Reveals Doctor Doom's Second-In-Command And They Sound Like [SPOILER]
item.description: Another Avengers: Doomsday rumour is getting fans talking today, as the identity of the masked figure who will serve as Doctor Doom's second-in-command has seemingly been revealed.

item.title: Marvel Comics Says Goodbye To Its Short-Lived Ultimate Universe With Striking New Variant Covers
item.description: This April, Marvel Comics says goodbye to the new Ultimate Universe with a series of eye-catching "Ultimate Farewell" variant covers that spotlight the line's most memorable creations.

item.title: SCREAM 7 Leaks Reveal Major Plot Points As First Reactions Land - SPOILERS
item.description: Thanks to some leaked footage, some major spoilers for Scream 7 are doing the rounds online. We also have the first social media reactions along with a handful of full reviews...
